apps.name: Tuna
apps.subtitle: Your music at home.
apps.localizedDescription: Your music from your Tuna server, with mixes and lyrics. Download songs to play offline.

versions.localizedDescription:
New
- Songs from Soulseek (Settings → Connections, under slskd): which copies of a song Tuna gets. Lossless, CD quality (the default now), Lossless, hi-res too, or MP3 320. Until now it took any lossless copy, so hi-res files of 100 MB or more a song came in. When nobody has the kind chosen, the nearest one comes instead.

To update: the server (pull the new image); the apps don't need updating.
